reviews.title: Gender Offenses
reviews.text: Hey y’all, as a 30 something woman, I get bothered enough on the daily about when my body should be creating a human life whether I want it or not, I don’t need it in an astrology app.  And I can promise I am nowhere near alone in this. There is literally nothing about astrology that should be “predicting” human life, this is not a period or ovulation app. Please remove this mysognist and frankly, invasive & plain rude part of your algorithm. Stop policing my body. Plenty of women struggle to get pregnant for years prior to conceiving, I imagine this would be extremely hurtful and offensive to them too. We are more than our bodies. I highly doubt there’s a “male”equivalent to this prompt I’ve received 3 times (the only one I’ve received multiple times I might add) since joining this app. Unless you are a period or ovulation app, you have no business talking about pregnancy or when my body should be “ready” stop telling women what to do with their bodies, in all capacities.

reviews.title: Charged me before they said they would & is expensive
reviews.text:
I recall when I signed up I signed up for the 3day trial where they said they’d charge me on the third day and so I went to cancel the subscription a little past midnight worrying they might have charged me already. They did but I didn’t realize they charged me at 9:55AM a whole DAY before they said I’d be charged!! I was able to submit a refund request through Apple so I’m hoping this will end well, but we shall see. 

I know I didn’t buy it on the 16th, because the day I said I’d opt in after downloading it was the 15th in the afternoon (before I took a screenshot at 4pm). The third day, when they said they’d charge me was supposed to be the 17th and even if we go by hours of time I had the app, it wasn’t even a full day. 

Readings and talking to psychics or whatever else they have are a ton of money and are not included in subscription prices. If I could indulge the app enough to test if the calls or texts were AI I’d ask how many of a specific letter was in a word a few times bc AI’s can’t do anything but make a guess at that due to how they process information differently than humans. Just in case anyone needs it. 

Outside of that, if anyone ultra rich wants to spend money on the app I guess it’s really clear and well designed. Wish I could say more but wow that app felt like it wanted to squeeze every penny out of me.

reviews.title: I expected answers not judgmental
reviews.text:
I’m very disappointed with this app. Some of the people on here are genuinely nice and helpful, but unfortunately, some are not.

One of my biggest issues happened when my account somehow got deleted. When I tried logging back in with the same information, it created a whole new account. Then I was questioned about why I supposedly had “a whole bunch of accounts.” I didn’t intentionally create multiple accounts—my original account was deleted, and trying to log back in created another one.

I was also criticized for asking the same or similar questions. Sometimes people repeat a question because they’re desperate for clarity, reassurance, or a better understanding of what they’re going through. That doesn’t mean they should be judged or treated badly.

After my experience, I personally don’t feel like this app is worth spending money on when you’re looking for answers. I’ve spent time on here hoping for genuine guidance, and instead I’ve walked away feeling disappointed and questioning whether the service is trustworthy.

At this point, I would rather go somewhere in person, such as Cassadaga, and speak with someone face-to-face. In my experience there, you don’t necessarily have to keep asking question after question—they can simply tell you what they feel or pick up on.

This is just my personal experience and opinion, but I feel like I wasted my time and money on this app. I expected a much better experience, and unfortunately, I’m leaving very disappointed.

reviews.title: This app really read me 😳
reviews.text:
What I love is how personalized everything feels. The birth chart breakdowns, compatibility insights, and daily guidance go deeper than your typical horoscope app, and sometimes the readings hit a little too close to home. It’s less about predicting your future and more about helping you reflect on what’s already going on internally.  

That said, be prepared for a lot of features to sit behind a paywall. Some users love the live psychic chats and find them accurate, while others feel like it can get a bit pricey or vague depending on the reader.  

Overall, I’d say it’s worth trying if you’re into spirituality, self-reflection, and a little cosmic guidance—but go in with intention, not blind trust.

First of all, the app is really just about talking to psychics and not much about astrology or spirit animals or any of that like the ads claim. 

Second, the app also makes you answer all these buzz feed quiz style questions and take a picture of your hand for a “palm reading” during the setup phase but never gives you the results of that.

And finally, the biggest scam of all: at the end of all the questions and such, it forces you to pay before you can see the results (that don’t exist). But here’s the kicker: it initially tells you what the actual price is but if you can’t afford that, it gives you other prices you could pay including $1. I chose the $1 option because I couldn’t afford to pay full price nor do I want to before I’ve even seen the results. I ultimately decided the app wasn’t worth it so I deleted it. Well, a few days later I got a notification from my bank about this very app trying to charge me $45. So I blocked the charge and redownloaded the app and had to play around in settings for 10 minutes before I found the “how to check for active subscriptions” button  and entered in my email and discovered that the app had, in fact, signed me up for a subscription that I didn’t want. And it wasn’t even premium! I still had the option to sign up for premium because I didn’t have it. So what the h**l is the $45 for?

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text:
There’s not much to it unless you pay for the subscription which is more than 100 annually. It’s not worth it. The only thing it really has to offer is the pretty graphics it provides and the fact that it’s easily accessible since it’s an app. But for the most part it’s straight up a gimmick and basic info you can get for free. Do the 3 day trial and see for yourself. You’ll be paying over $100 for an app you’ll either get bored of quickly or won’t really benefit from very much. You can get a detailed horoscope reading and natal charts from many websites online for free or for way way cheaper. Save your money. Note: I read many of the comments/reviews for the app and the developer is great at responding however; they keep apologizing for typos or things not working correctly by saying they’re actively working on fixing these errors and they underestimated the time it would take to include some things (these are just examples). That’s a problem because, again, you’re being charged over $100 for an app that isn’t even complete or working the way it “should be”. This is $50 dollars more than your average video game, or streaming subscription. It is straight up a rip off and they know it. They push the yearly subscription yet claim they have so much to offer for free, they need to realize that their app is not worth $100.

Also a lot of the reviews on here seem to be bots/falsified. I see more negative reviews than positive ones yet they have 4+ rating. Doesn’t make sense.

reviews.title: Beware: Unsettlingly Accurate
reviews.text: I’ve never been ‘all in’ on astrology. It’s been something that I’ve checked in on from time to time in order to amuse myself, that’s it. Since downloading the Nebula app I’ve become a believer. I’ve had very specific events reflected with unnerving precision in my daily horoscopes as well as practical advice and observations that are perhaps mundane but incredibly insightful nonetheless, (“you’ve developed a habit of eating sugary snacks late in the evening; this is terrible for the health of your teeth.” Umm, yes; I had developed that habit and the point was certainly appreciated.) Nebula is absolutely worth the investment of your time whether you’re a dilettante or a die hard.

reviews.title: Love the insight but…
reviews.text:
As freakily accurate as the chart is, I am just now discovering there are various many other things that are taken into account—like your Pallas Sign among one…

I paid for the lifetime thing and I hope that eventually in the future you include more of the other various miscellaneous things besides the planets!

I’m excited to find out more!

Also, if there is a way to include more info on some of the chart items like with the significance of the percentages for modality and also elements and fem/masc thing? Like maybe if I long pressed on the little percentage chart it could explain it more? Possibly? For example, it says I am a fixed sign under traits (I’m an Aquarius!) but doesn’t explain the significance of my modality actually having the largest percentage in mutable?

Otherwise. I love this app a lot and I showed my chart to my friends and they were astounded at how scarily accurate its description of me was.

I also (sorry I’m asking for so much stuff, but I will use this app for as long as you exist!!!) would love to possibly see in the future a section that can kinda summarize our overall strengths but also areas we may have a tendency to be weak in or areas to be on the lookout for to focus on for enhanced personal growth!

Please and thank you, Nebula Team!

Keep up the good work and love the app!!!

You can’t send messages after that, not even to apologize to the psychics for wasting their time. EVERYTHING on the app costs money. Every single feature. At this point, just buy tarot cards or a book on astrology. You’ll get way more bang for your buck that way.

reviews.title: This app is a Scam
reviews.text:
The way Nebula’s psychics charge by the minute is extremely misleading and feels exploitative. You’re charged not just while the psychic is actively responding, but also while you’re typing your question and even while waiting for them to reply. On top of that, you’re forced to keep paying just to read the response once it finally comes through.

This means a simple question can end up costing far more than expected, even if the psychic takes time to respond or sends short, vague answers. There’s no real pause or transparency in the billing, so your balance drains even when no actual interaction is happening.

It feels designed to nickel-and-dime users rather than provide genuine guidance. I wouldn’t recommend this app unless you’re comfortable spending a lot of money very quickly with little control.

reviews.title: Good for daily horoscope, but readings feel rooted in greed.
reviews.text: This app is very well made, and it is great for the daily horoscope and other information like your birth charts and much more information about you. However, I feel as if the prices for the readings are rooted in greed, and the paywall would be best for those making $100,000 per year or more. You get 3 minutes for free then every minute is 30-60 pts. 10 points is the equivalent of $1. So a ten minute conversation by text will cost you roughly $30. Not to mention the reading people will be on and off the conversation sometimes so you are occasionally paying while they are talking to someone else. This is definitely a critical issue. They need to rearrange the app to where you can schedule a 15ish minute reading for a reasonable price and have the reader exclusively. Some readers go up to 60 pts or $6 dollars a minute. I have local readings at a place that charges about $70 for 30 minutes. So I certainly feel like the prices on the app are quite excessive in my opinion. They are also basically sales people as random readers text me in the app every day to chat with them for money per minute. Decent app but a minute goes by instantly and it can take 2 minutes for them to even respond or look at your question.

My boyfriend hasn’t received a single notification like this (about marriage and kids). I am not even near the average age that people have children and got so fed up with these notifications that I deleted the app. I also didn’t enjoy the interface and noticed quite a few grammatical errors, but this wouldn’t have made me stop using the app if it wasn’t sending me misogynistic notifications all day about personal life events that I don’t even care for at the moment.

reviews.title: Waste of time and $$$
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app thinking it would be worth wild, however, I was sadly mistaken. I’m a HUGE astrology enthusiast who has already done most research into my birth chart. After seeing an ad for the app I thought, “WTH why not give it a shot.” When it comes down to it this app has a lot of work to do to not only for convenience but also functionally. 

After downloading the app the first thing that rubbed me wrong was the amount of times I was asked to subscribe (sign-up for a membership). The first time I was prompted I didn’t know it was optional until I noticed the X (close button) in the top right corner. However, after closing the subscription screen I was prompted several more times to subscribe in order to do almost anything on the app. The basic functions of the app are horoscopes and your personal birth chart, which are free. These can pretty much be found on ANY website for free and are just as accurate if not better on other websites.  

Secondly, I noticed that I accidentally put in the wrong birth time. When trying to correct this mistake I realized that there was no way to correct it or at the very least it is very difficult to find.

Overall, in my opinion this app is not worth the time nor amount of $$$ for the features. The only thing I like about this app is the features it has such as the palmistry, however, you need to subscribe for $119 (annual) or 9.99 (monthly) to be able to access many or these features.

reviews.title: DO NOT RISK IT.
reviews.text:
I got this app on a whim three months ago. I used it for one day and realized it was trash, so I unsubscribed and deleted it on my phone, and made sure it was off my subscriptions list on my iPhone (all the things you are supposed to do when cancelling an app). 
Every month since then NEBULA HAS BEEN CHARGING ME. I go online to their main website for support, it is EXTREMELY deluded, there really is no information regarding customer issues or care. So I go to Apple support to report the app and get reimbursement, but because my iPhone and Apple both think this app is and has been unsubscribed and cancelled, I cannot select it for reporting and get reimbursement. I called my bank, luckily they were able to block Nebula for all future payments, but I do still need to file my claim to hopefully get my money back. After dealing with this annoyance for the last couple months I decided to go online and do a little more research on nebula reviews, turns out there are tons of people just like me with shockingly similar stories pertaining to being charged LONG AFTER their nebula subscription was cancelled. 

IMO I wouldn’t risk it, it’s been a hassle to get my 60 bucks back, and to be honest I think if I didn’t notice I was being charged monthly in the first place, AND if I wasn’t putting in the work now to stop Nebula, this would have just kept going on and on. 
This app was made by imbeciles, I don’t think it’s necessarily an intentional scam, but the tech is just so pitiful, a 5 year old could do better. Just save yourself the money and the trouble, there are other silly horoscope apps out there.

I’m not surprised that people who think balls of gas billions of miles away determine your fate also believe in the gender binary, but I’m still docking points.

reviews.text:
I’ve been using  for a while now, and honestly it’s become part of my daily routine. The horoscopes feel surprisingly accurate and personalized instead of generic like a lot of astrology apps out there. I love how easy the app is to use, and the design is calming and beautiful without being overwhelming.

The birth chart insights, compatibility features, and spiritual guidance sections are my favorite parts. They give you a lot to explore whether you’re deeply into astrology or just curious and learning. I also appreciate that the app feels encouraging and reflective instead of negative or fear-based.

Definitely worth downloading if you enjoy astrology, self-discovery, or just starting your day with a little insight and positivity. 5 stars from me.
